# AudioVisualizer — Line envelope

> A smooth envelope showing the same amplitude history.

Status: beta.

This file matches the installed `audio-visualizer-line` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/audio-visualizer-line.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/audio-visualizer-line.md`.

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { AudioVisualizer } from "@/components/control-ui/audio-visualizer-line";

  return <AudioVisualizerDemo Visualizer={AudioVisualizer} label="Line envelope" />;
}
```
